name: Sedna bridge (LLM-free)
purpose: Drive the Sedna decision-support stack from a DSH instance: knowledge retrieval over the canonical KB, engagement journal reads and writes, and knowledge-index maintenance — all without a host LLM.

runtime.dependencies: none beyond the Node and Python standard libraries

requires.note: the tree Hermes runs; the driver puts it on sys.path and imports sedna.*
canonical artifacts, manifests, engagement journals and the disposable retrieval index

requires.what: A Python interpreter able to import the Sedna package
requires.note: usually the Sedna virtualenv; the host python3 works only if sedna is importable from it

notProvided.why: the planning path needs a host structured-completion facade (Hermes supplies ctx.llm); DSH exposes none to a file plugin, and this plugin deliberately makes no model call
the promotion saga is not bridged; close and verify remain Hermes-side operations
ingestion requires the semantic extraction host

writeSurface.bridgeGuard: resume and abandon require confirm=true; the guard marks the call deliberate, it is not a security boundary
writeSurface.warning: measured 2026-09-20: a lane never bound to any engagement successfully abandoned an arbitrary engagement

configKeys.sednaSrc: Sedna source tree placed on sys.path

install.restartRequired: yes — the row is read at DSH start
